listing.name: Fable II Pub Games (MGRayd Recomp)
listing.summary: Windows player for the Xbox 360 Pub Games, with an optional upstream save link.

steps.title: Import your own Pub Games container
steps.instruction: Keep the launcher, game executable, DLLs and extraction tool together. Open Fable2PubGamesLauncher.exe, choose your own Xbox 360 Pub Games container, and use Install Game Files before Play Pub Games.

steps.title: Preserve the upstream data
steps.instruction: The launcher creates data, saves, logs and cache in its folder. Keep the original container and preserve the creating runtime and actual save folder before replacement.

steps.title: Review optional Fable II save sync separately
steps.instruction: The upstream Advanced Options can link the Fable II Recompiled saves folder and sync when Pub Games closes. This can update Fable2PubInfo.xml bridge records in the other game’s profile. Keep your own backups as well as the upstream pubgames-sync-backups, and close both games before any maintenance. Leave sync off for independent profiles.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
The upstream launcher owns the import and game handoff. Selecting the launcher or its script does not establish managed installation or save synchronization in Portcove.
